name: Allgens Medical Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Allgens Medical Technology Co. Ltd. operates as a medical device firm, concentrating on the development and production of sophisticated biomimetic synthetic bone graft systems. These innovative solutions are engineered for global deployment in areas where both cancellous (spongy) and cortical (dense outer layer) bone tissues have been compromised. The company's diverse product portfolio includes key offerings such as BonGold, a mineralized collagen scaffold designed for bone grafting procedures; the high-performance Alligator bone marrow aspirator; and OssaNova, a mineralized collagen-based material utilized for bone filling and augmentation. These products are broadly applied across a spectrum of orthopedic and skeletal repair interventions throughout the human anatomy. Allgens Medical Technology Co. Ltd. was established in 2004 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
